As Oracle Corp (ORCL) Stock Value Rose, Stoneridge Investment Partners LLC Raised Its Holding
October 17, 2018 - By Margaret Guttierez
Investors sentiment decreased to 0.82 in Q2 2018. Its down 0.05, from 0.87 in 2018Q1. It turned negative, as 73 investors sold ORCL shares while 564 reduced holdings. 107 funds opened positions while 414 raised stakes. 2.13 billion shares or 5.10% less from 2.24 billion shares in 2018Q1 were reported. 79,145 are held by Lee Danner Bass. Hanson & Doremus Invest reported 0.02% stake. Richard Bernstein Limited Liability Company reported 0.36% in Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL). Moreover, Amer Natl Bank has 0% invested in Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL). Lincluden Mgmt Ltd accumulated 0.26% or 79,645 shares. Black Creek Inv Management holds 8.74% or 6.51 million shares in its portfolio. Ing Groep Nv accumulated 18,997 shares. Savings Bank Of The West invested 0.3% in Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL). Ghp Investment Advisors Inc invested in 0.52% or 84,236 shares. Veritas Investment Mgmt Llp has invested 0.13% of its portfolio in Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL). The Connecticut-based Northcoast Asset Mgmt Ltd Com has invested 0.2% in Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL). Sumitomo Life Insur Co holds 0.47% or 87,502 shares in its portfolio. Sumitomo Mitsui Asset Company holds 1.94M shares or 1.32% of its portfolio. 72,762 are owned by Wetherby Asset Mgmt. 9,830 are owned by Vantage Invest Advsrs Ltd Liability Company.
Stoneridge Investment Partners Llc increased its stake in Oracle Corp (ORCL) by 61.51% based on its latest 2018Q2 regulatory filing with the SEC. Stoneridge Investment Partners Llc bought 103,124 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.22% with the market. The institutional investor held 270,791 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2018Q2, valued at $11.93M, up from 167,667 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stoneridge Investment Partners Llc who had been investing in Oracle Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $182.73B market cap company. The stock increased 2.36% or $1.11 during the last trading session, reaching $48.23. About 13.60 million shares traded. Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) has declined 6.50% since October 17, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 22.12% the S&P500.
Stoneridge Investment Partners Llc, which manages about $1.01B and $518.83M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Amazon Com Inc (NASDAQ:AMZN) by 3,044 shares to 9,455 shares, valued at $16.07M in 2018Q2, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Colgate (NYSE:CL) by 98,338 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 24,798 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).

Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) Ratings Coverage
Among 16 analysts covering Oracle Corp ( NYSE:ORCL ), 6 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 10 Hold. Therefore 38% are positive. Oracle Corp has $6300 highest and $48 lowest target. $54.73’s average target is 13.48% above currents $48.23 stock price. Oracle Corp had 20 analyst reports since May 17, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Tuesday, September 18 by Nomura. On Tuesday, September 18 the stock rating was maintained by Wells Fargo with “Outperform”. Stifel Nicolaus maintained Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) on Tuesday, September 18 with “Hold” rating. JP Morgan downgraded the stock to “Neutral” rating in Thursday, June 14 report. Nomura maintained Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) on Thursday, June 14 with “Buy” rating. Citigroup maintained Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) rating on Tuesday, September 18. Citigroup has “Neutral” rating and $49 target. UBS maintained the shares of ORCL in report on Wednesday, June 20 with “Neutral” rating. On Wednesday, June 20 the stock rating was downgraded by Wedbush to “Hold”. The firm has “Buy” rating by Bernstein given on Wednesday, June 20. As per Wednesday, June 20, the company rating was maintained by Stifel Nicolaus.
